hardware.reported_setup: User confirmed 24 V, MS1/MS2/MS3 unconnected (board pull-ups select 1/16), 3.3 V jumper bridged, common ground connected. Motor current limit not adjusted; VREF and cart motor rated phase current unknown. On 2026-09-16 user changed to 20T and reported comfortable 600 RPM and 20,000 RPM/s limits. On 2026-09-17 user switched back to 60T, retaining the same linear limits (0.8/12/12/60).

measured_pendulum.calibration_note: Refit 33 same-side decaying cycles with both peaks between 5 and 20 degrees from the three 175 mm / 14.2 g captures. Equivalent viscous damping is descriptive; pivot friction is not fully identified.

safety_note: Without limit switches, rail position is inferred from commanded steps. A skipped step makes that estimate wrong. Validate manual motion and balance-only mode before automatic swing-up.

validation.checks: v21 pin uniqueness and real driver direction/DDS/disable harness, 16 simulator groups and ESP32 compile pass; not uploaded.
validation.startup_response_fault: Stops automatic startup after 2 s and >30 mm cumulative commanded travel if pendulum excursion stays below 0.03 rad. This is not general stall detection.
validation.candidate_note: v21 cart STEP25/DIR26, Z1 STEP18/DIR19, Z2 STEP16/DIR17. All geometry, linear motion limits and controller behavior retained.
validation.latest_physical_review: 2026-09-15 20:23 local: v4 trials reached 57.3 and 179.2 degrees from down, but no sustained balance; latter included a startup nonresponse fault. User runtime amax_s=5/jmax=50/ke=2.5 reached 105.3 degrees after another nonresponse fault. Repository settings held unchanged pending physical tracking confirmation.
validation.prior_revision_note: v17 upright-only validation reported an unrelated frequency GUI test failure; see analysis/upright_tuning.md.

rail_recovery.position_source: commanded steps; no homing or endstop sensor

spin_recovery.speed_measurement: magnitude of filtered theta_dot; valid encoder required
spin_recovery.resume_cart_condition: within 3 mm of startup center, |v|<=0.005 m/s and |a|<=0.1 m/s^2
spin_recovery.scope: automatic swing-up, automatic balance and automatic rail recovery; upright-only bal retains separate fall-return-stop behavior

serial.reconnect: same port; valid STOP acknowledgment and three consecutive valid telemetry frames; never replay motion
serial.user_report: User reports USB/serial problems resolved after disconnecting ESP32 power feed from motor-power breakout; not independently measured.

encoder_calibration.mapping: uniform count scale, absolute measured upright; no quadrant correction
encoder_calibration.quality_note: One sample per pose; corrupted serial text and inconsistent zero_raw/status fields occur in this session. Full nonlinearity is not established.

upright_only.fall_detection: absolute calibrated raw angle, wrapped about upright count 3416
upright_only.return: brake, center to within 3mm at <=0.1m/s and <=0.5m/s2 return acceleration, disable; explicit bal required to restart
upright_only.rail_protection: upright trial aborts and centers; hard rail or sensor/link fault disables immediately
upright_only.physical_trial: v18: seven upright attempts, all rail aborts; v19 direction flip prepared, not uploaded
